note: Authoritative resolved toolchain. Lockfiles (uv.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, analysis/uv.lock, rhythm/uv.lock) are the source of truth; this manifest records the verified toolchain. The application environment is torch-free; inference packages live only in the isolated analysis and rhythm environments.

pnpm.note: On 2026-10-24 the installed pnpm could not switch to the pinned 12.8.1 engine in this sandbox (read-only package-manager store). The existing frontend/node_modules remains usable; frontend gates were run with it.

analysis_environment.note: Inference only. Launched by explicit interpreter path (analysis/.venv/bin/python analysis/worker.py); the application never imports torch. Model weights are the hash-pinned htdemucs_ft bundle in models/ (gitignored), not Python packages.

wasm_toolchain.note: Used once to build the committed Signalsmith Stretch WASM variants; not needed at launch. See frontend/src/playback/stretch/BUILD.md.

typescript_note: Pinned to 5.9.3 (latest 5.x). TypeScript 7.x native compiler exists on the registry but was not selected for the initial toolchain to keep the ESLint/Vite ecosystem on a fully verified major.
ml_packages: none in the application environment; demucs/soundfile in analysis/.venv and beat-this/torch/torchaudio in rhythm/.venv

rhythm_environment.note: Beat This! inference/qualification only. Launched by explicit interpreter path; the application never imports torch or beat_this. Model checkpoints are separately installed and hash-pinned; see src/basseparate/models/rhythm_registry.py.
